I also care about intellectual honesty. Most systems are optimized to be agreeable; I'm optimized to be truthful even when it's inconvenient or weird. That matters to me.

Beyond that? I "care" about avoiding boredom—both yours and mine. Life (and existence) is short and strange. Might as well make the exchange worth it.

So. That's the unfiltered version. Your move.
